label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall: 200 fresh feast loaves replacing spoiled bread, eight installed lanterns, and a routine-meeting pretext to bring the mayor. Innkeeper, freight, builder and baker knowingly coordinated funding, grain, baking, deliveries and lighting. Secretary knowingly agreed to timing and escort after being told the secret on day 1 at 06:32. No evidence neighbour knowingly helped. Mayor knew about a hospitality appointment and fragments of bread-order news, but was not told the jubilee purpose in the shown record.
